title: OrganizationSpendLimitResource

object.description: The object type, which is always `organization.spend_limit`.

threshold_amount.description: The hard spend limit amount, in cents.

currency.description: The currency for the threshold amount. Currently, only `USD` is supported.

interval.description: The time interval for evaluating spend against the threshold. Currently, only `month` is supported.

enforcement.description: The current enforcement state of the hard spend limit.

description: Represents a hard spend limit configured at the organization level.
